kind: PROSPECTIVE CONFIRMATION (research only; no bets, recommendations, SIFT badges, staking or automatic wagers)

wave1_provenance.rb_receptions_always_no_posthoc: n 223 (2025 T-90m 140, 2026 LAST_PREGAME 83), ROI +10.6% [-1.0, +22.9]; post-hoc comparator, not pre-registered in Wave 1

population.no_backfill: Only games whose OBSERVATION record was written strictly before kickoff by the research job. A population game with no observation by kickoff is SYSTEM_FAILURE and is never reconstructed later.
population.player_identity: Kalshi player -> GSIS with the Wave-1 resolver (signal_discovery.markets.Resolver) on the season roster, accepted ONLY as RESOLVED_NAME_TEAM or RESOLVED_NAME_TEAM_JERSEY (Kalshi team code normalised by markets.TEAM_FIX). Name-only matches and unresolved players -> IDENTITY_FAILURE. The Kalshi player UUID is recorded.

pregame_features.game_layer: signal_discovery.game_features.game_rows (sim-oppadj-1.0.0 solver, snapshot at (2026, week) on strictly earlier games) with the FROZEN 2026 per-metric lambdas of research/signal_discovery_wave1/game_features_manifest.json (never re-chosen)
pregame_features.player_layer: signal_discovery.player_features.build semantics on the upcoming week: nflverse sim features (decayed shares, last-game shares, rates shrunk to the frozen 2012-2015 priors, team volume EWMAs) computed with PHANTOM rows for the week's eligible players (nfl_edge.sim.features.player_features phantom_rows; the row itself is never read), joined to the team-perspective game context (CONTEXT_MAP) and evaluate_props.add_baselines.
pregame_features.role_stability: player_features._role_stability, unchanged (source SHA-256 above). INJURY input = the latest injury-report vintage captured at or before the observation instant (nfl_edge.sim.prospective.injury_vintage), instead of Wave-1's final weekly nflverse file (declared NEAR_PIT there). Thresholds unchanged: n_prior < 3 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE_HISTORY; own Q/D or a higher-share same-position teammate Out/Doubtful INJURY_DEPENDENT; |short - long primary share| >= 0.10 or |snap_share_s - snap_share_l| >= 0.15 ROLE_CHANGE; else STABLE_ROLE.
pregame_features.observation_window: the observation is written at the first research run inside [kickoff-300 min, kickoff-20 min]; generated_at < kickoff is enforced

prop_checkpoint.rule: Per rung: nfl_edge.evaluation.close CloseIndex.select(ticker) (rule close-2.1.0: the last complete valid pre-kickoff observation of the exact contract on the change-suppressed capture, confirmed by the last complete series fetch while the ticker was open). Accepted when close_status is CLOSE_OK or CLOSE_ONE_SIDED, kickoff-24h < confirmed_at < kickoff, and the price row was observed strictly before kickoff. Status must be open/active. Nothing after kickoff is ever read.
prop_checkpoint.valid_rung: 0 < yes_bid <= yes_ask < 1 and yes_ask - yes_bid <= 0.10 (Wave-1 markets._valid); mid = (yes_bid + yes_ask)/2
prop_checkpoint.market_median: Wave-1 markets.ladder_median over valid (threshold, mid) rungs: interpolated threshold where P(stat >= t) crosses 0.5 at the first consecutive pair p1 >= 0.5 >= p2, p1 != p2; none -> missing
prop_checkpoint.natural_rung: the valid rung minimising |mid - 0.5|; TIE-BREAK FROZEN HERE: the lowest threshold (Wave-1 left ties to iteration order)
prop_checkpoint.asks: side-specific captured asks; NO is never 1 - YES; an ask that is not a whole cent in [0.01, 0.99] is not executable
prop_checkpoint.fee: nfl_edge.execution.fees.load_fee_schedule(repo).taker_fee(price, 1.0, series_ticker, as_of=confirmed_at); a non-KNOWN state -> FEE_UNAVAILABLE, never 0

game_checkpoint.declared: NEW prospective test condition (Wave 1 used the untimestamped nflverse consensus closing total)
game_checkpoint.rule: Per KXNFLTOTAL rung: the last capture run whose complete series fetch observed the ticker open with confirmed instant in [kickoff-180, kickoff-60] (CaptureRuns.confirmation evaluated at the window close), its price being the last written row at or before that instant. No run in the window -> ENTRY_UNAVAILABLE. Nothing outside the window is searched.
game_checkpoint.market_implied_total: markets.ladder_median over the valid (threshold, mid) total rungs at the checkpoint (same validity rule as props); never called fair or true total
game_checkpoint.natural_rung: valid rung minimising |mid - 0.5|, tie -> lowest threshold

settlement.props: Contract: the exchange's own result for the exact ticker when published (market-data discovery settled/closed buckets); otherwise the nflverse weekly stat of a player with >= 1 offensive snap (threshold t means stat >= t; no push). No exchange result and no participation proof -> SETTLEMENT_PENDING. Accuracy metrics (ROLE_CHANGE) need the realised stat of a player who played; a player who did not play -> EXCLUDED_PROTOCOL (DID_NOT_PLAY).
settlement.totals: final home + away score including overtime from the nflverse schedule; YES on threshold t pays iff total >= t; NO iff total < t
settlement.append_only: write-once record files (OBSERVATION, ENTRY, SETTLEMENT) under market-data data/research/signal_lab_wave2/; a frozen record is never rewritten
settlement.clv: side-aware, same ticker and side, the canonical close (close-2.1.0) minus the entry ask; missing close stays missing

NFL-PROP-PROS-001.name: RB_RECEPTIONS_NO_STRUCTURE
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.wording: On eligible running-back receptions ladders, purchasing NO on the natural rung selected by the pre-registered ladder rule at the actual captured NO ask produces positive fee-adjusted ROI prospectively.
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.market_structure_note: market-structure research, not a player edge
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.eligible: KXNFLREC ladder (stat receptions, operator >=) of a GSIS-identified player who is in the pregame RB_receptions family: position RB, sh_target_l >= 0.05, n_prior >= 3, b_season.receptions defined (Wave-1 evaluate_props.family_rows); the ladder has a market median and a natural rung at LAST_VALID_PREKICK_QUOTE_24H
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.contract: NO on the natural rung at its captured no_ask, one research contract, taker fee
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.primary_question: fee-adjusted ROI on outlay > 0 (game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI)
NFL-PROP-PROS-001.falsified: fee-adjusted ROI <= 0 at n >= 300 settled -> REJECTED

NFL-PROP-PROS-002.name: ROLE_CHANGE_MODEL_ADVANTAGE
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.wording: On player-prop ladders classified ROLE_CHANGE before kickoff, the frozen Wave-1 player projection is more accurate than the market line median at predicting the realized player statistic.
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.eligible: pregame family row (Wave-1 family_rows) with role_stability == ROLE_CHANGE; GSIS-identified Kalshi ladder of the family's Kalshi stat with a market median at LAST_VALID_PREKICK_QUOTE_24H
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.model: the Wave-1 ridge (lambda 1, PROP_MODEL features and interactions) of the 2026 walk-forward fold (train 2016-2025), serialized and hashed before the first population kickoff; model median = pred + median_offset. Never refit in Wave 2.
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.primary_metric: d = |market_median - actual| - |model_median - actual| (positive = the model wins); per player-game, the mean of d over that player-game's eligible families; primary = mean over player-games, game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.no_rule: no 'bet when the model differs by X' rule is created
NFL-PROP-PROS-002.falsified: mean d <= 0 at n >= 200 settled player-games -> REJECTED

NFL-GAME-PROS-001.name: TOTALS_DISAGREEMENT_WF
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.wave1_source: WF-TOTAL (hypotheses_set1 walk_forward): OLS of total_resid on [gap.total, env.plays, env.sec_per_play, def_quality_sum.epa, off_quality_sum.epa] + intercept, train seasons < test
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.artifact: the same procedure's 2026 fold (train 2015-2025, identical Wave-1 corpus), serialized and hashed BEFORE the first population kickoff, with proof that the procedure reproduces the Wave-1 2018-2025 fold coefficients exactly. Never refit in Wave 2.
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.market_translation: m.total := market_implied_total at NFL_PRIMARY_60_180, so gap.total = baseline.total - market_implied_total; prediction p = artifact(features)
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.side: OVER if p > 0, UNDER if p < 0
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.contract: natural total rung; OVER = YES at yes_ask, UNDER = NO at no_ask; taker fee (series KXNFLTOTAL)
NFL-GAME-PROS-001.falsified: mean side-signed residual <= 0 at n >= 200 -> REJECTED

verdict_rule: n settled below the first read -> PROSPECTIVE_TRACKING; at/after a read -> that read's state; at/after PRIMARY_REVIEW n: falsified -> REJECTED, otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED (a human decides; nothing is promoted by code).

statistics.intervals: 95% game-clustered bootstrap percentile, 4,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261015); Wilson 95% for rates
statistics.empty: NO SETTLED SAMPLE (n 0 is never shown as 0)
